title: BLANK / 0 is BLANK: a BLANK numerator makes the quotient BLANK

source.supports: a BLANK numerator gives BLANK even over a denominator that counts as zero
zero over zero is NaN: the other reading, if the BLANK numerator is taken as 0

derivation: No source shows BLANK / 0. A BLANK numerator gives BLANK over 4 and over BLANK (which is zero as a denominator), so it is taken to give BLANK over 0 too.
alternative: The BLANK numerator is converted to 0 and 0 / 0 is NaN (a double).
